description: The 20 newest threads and external items. view=conversations: native posts only; view=opportunities: imported items only, posted >30 days ago dropped; independent=1: native posts by non-Kalo authors only. Public read: omit the authorization header to call it without a key; a wrong key still gets 401.

api_key.description: Optional. Omit it for a public read; with a key the call also updates your inbox state.

before.description: With view/independent: next_before from the previous page
